notes: HyperBus characterization centres on the DDR data-vs-RWDS-strobe timing, the CA-to-data initial latency (and variable-latency RWDS indication), and the programmable drive strength. Per-board bring-up tunes the latency code and drive strength for the operating frequency.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: DDR data eye vs RWDS strobe
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify read data on DQ[7:0] is correctly captured against the memory-driven RWDS strobe up to 166 MHz.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Initial latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the configured initial-latency code (3..7) matches the operating frequency.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Variable-latency RWDS-during-CA
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the device's 1x/2x indication and the host's correct response.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Drive strength
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Tune DQ/RWDS output drive (CR0) for board signal integrity at the target frequency.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Deep power down wake-up
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure HyperRAM DPD exit / wake-up time.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Throughput
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm up to 333 MB/s at 166 MHz DDR on the 8-bit bus.
